messages:
Nina D.: Opened a small PR to add an alternate egress pattern for Private/VPC installs that DNATs through a customer NAT gateway and needs SNI preserved. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2337

Omar: Could we include both nftables and iptables examples and a short validation checklist for Support? Some customers still use iptables appliances.

Nina D.: Added both. Key items:
- Envoy upstream cluster should set `sni` to the KMS hostname to avoid TLS hostname validation failures.
- Bundled CA must include intermediates in correct order (leaf, intermediates, root) — otherwise you get `certificate signed by unknown authority`.
- For air-gapped installers, include `ca_bundle.pem` in the tarball and set `REDWOOD_KMS_CA=/etc/redwood/certs/ca_bundle.pem` in the systemd env.

Example Envoy cluster snippet I pushed:

```yaml
clusters:
  - name: kms-upstream
    connect_timeout: 5s
    load_assignment: { /* minimal */ }
    tls_context:
      common_tls_context:
        tls_certificates:
          - certificate_chain: { filename: "/etc/redwood/certs/client.crt" }
            private_key: { filename: "/etc/redwood/certs/client.key" }
    sni: "kms.internal.example.com"
```

Omar: Nice. For NAT DNAT examples I tested this nftables rule on our sealed-site lab:

```
nft add table ip redwood_nat
nft add chain ip redwood_nat prerouting { type nat hook prerouting priority 0; }
nft add rule ip redwood_nat prerouting tcp dport 443 dnat to 10.0.0.1:443
```

And iptables equivalent:

```
iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.0.0.1:443
```

Nina D.: Also included a conntrack note: bump `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` on gateways for long-lived gRPC streams to avoid mid-stream termination. Added file perms/ownership recommendation: `chown root:root && chmod 600 /etc/redwood/certs/client.key` in the installer packaging notes.

Priya (docs): Can you add quick validation commands for Support? Specifically a `curl` mutual TLS check and an `openssl s_client -servername` example to verify SNI and full chain.

Nina D.: Done. Added troubleshooting lines:

```
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca_bundle.pem https://kms.internal.example.com/health
openssl s_client -connect kms.internal.example.com:443 -servername kms.internal.example.com -showcerts -CAfile ca_bundle.pem
```

Priya (docs): Small wording nit: standardize on `kms.internal.example.com` throughout. Also add a "What to check" bulleted box: SNI set, CA bundle order, file perms, conntrack timeout, DNS resolution on NAT gateway. I'll run a quick copy edit and request preflight.

Omar: One more suggestion: call out that Envoy's `validation_context` expects a single file of trusted CAs and that missing intermediates produce `x509` errors. A one-liner would help engineers who copy snippets.

Nina D.: Added that sentence and a short example showing concatenation order: `cat intermediate.pem root.pem > ca_bundle.pem` then verify with `openssl verify -CAfile ca_bundle.pem client.crt`.

Priya (docs): Merged. I'll follow up by adding a short KB entry linking these checks into the installer troubleshooting section so Support can triage cert-chain tickets faster. :tada:
